product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Deco Black Accordion Arm Wall Mount Sconce Light Fixture with Metal Shade - 20 x 28 x 6 Inches, Dark Bronze with Brass Accent
product.description: This cleverly designed sconce mounts easily on a wall to bring light to spots that may not be convenient for a lamp or chandelier. Accordion-like hardware allows it to be pulled out and pushed back to suit your needs -- for more light or more space! Modern, clean style Metal hardware and shade with black finish, brass accent, and on/off switch on cord Strong modern style that adjusts in and out to meet your space needs 20"H x 28"W x 6"D Simple assembly (plug into existing outlet--no hardwiring required) Intended for indoor use only
